questions.stem: The company accountant was arrested for ( ) after it was discovered she had stolen almost a million dollars from the company over five years.
questions.translation: 会社の会計担当者は、5年間で会社から約100万ドルを盗んだことが発覚し、横領で逮捕された。

questions.stem: The film has received much ( ) for its excellent storytelling and its cinematic beauty. In fact, it has already won two major awards.
questions.translation: その映画は優れた物語と映像美で大きな称賛を受け、すでに主要な賞を2つ獲得している。

questions.stem: It was widely known that the government was ( ) with corruption. It was common for officials to demand money before performing even the simplest of services.
questions.translation: 政府が汚職にまみれていることは広く知られていた。役人が最も簡単なサービスを行う前にも金を要求するのが普通だった。

questions.stem: While one might expect to be tired following a workout, many people find that they actually feel ( ) after moderate exercise.
questions.translation: 運動後は疲れると思うかもしれないが、適度な運動の後は実際には元気になったと感じる人が多い。

questions.stem: Leilani thought it was useless to ( ) her current financial situation, so instead of complaining, she decided to look for a higherpaying job.
questions.translation: レイラニは現在の経済状況を嘆いても無駄だと思い、愚痴を言う代わりに、もっと給料の高い仕事を探すことにした。

questions.stem: After two workers were injured on the job, safety took on ( ) importance at the factory. Huge sums of money were spent to ensure all the latest safety standards were met.
questions.translation: 2人の作業員が仕事中にけがをした後、工場では安全が最重要になった。最新の安全基準を満たすため多額の費用が使われた。

questions.stem: Although Jackie's parents ( ) her not to quit school, Jackie ignored them and began working as a yoga instructor.
questions.translation: ジャッキーの両親は学校を辞めないよう彼女に懇願したが、彼女は聞かず、ヨガ講師として働き始めた。

questions.stem: Although he feared the champion, the boxer made a show of ( ) at the media conference by saying he would knock him out in the first round.
questions.translation: 王者を恐れていたが、そのボクサーは記者会見で第1ラウンドに相手を倒すと言い、強がってみせた。

questions.stem: The bank's hightech safedeposit boxes are thought to be ( ). "We are 100 percent confident no one can break into the boxes to steal our customers' valuables," said the manager.
questions.translation: 銀行のハイテク金庫は、侵入して顧客の貴重品を盗むことができないと考えられている。

questions.stem: Astronauts bravely risk their lives in order to explore space. The reward for these ( ) people, though, is a view unlike any other.
questions.translation: 宇宙飛行士は宇宙探査のため勇敢に命をかける。その勇敢な人々への報酬は、他にない景色である。

questions.stem: After being ( ) for nearly a decade, it was difficult for Brian to adjust to life outside of prison.
questions.translation: 10年近く投獄されていたため、ブライアンは刑務所の外の生活に慣れるのが難しかった。

questions.stem: Relations between the two countries are in a state of ( ), and neither side is willing to sit down to work out a solution.
questions.translation: 両国の関係は不和の状態にあり、どちらの側も解決策を話し合うために席に着こうとしない。

questions.stem: The politician was caught on camera attempting to pay off a reporter ( ). He thought no one would see him, but the camera's zoom lens revealed everything.
questions.translation: その政治家は記者に賄賂を渡そうとしているところを、目立たないように撮影されていた。

questions.stem: A: Have you received the ( ) of tools we ordered? B: No, but the supplier says it should arrive within the week.
questions.translation: 注文した道具の一式は届いたか。まだだが、仕入れ先は週内に届くはずだと言っている。

questions.stem: The candidate's campaign was undermined by the ( ) of her character through persistent rumors and lies spread by her opponents.
questions.translation: 候補者の選挙運動は、対立候補が広めたうわさや嘘による人格攻撃で弱体化した。

questions.stem: The journalist was fired for publishing ( ) articles. His claims were often based on little to no evidence.
questions.translation: そのジャーナリストは根拠がほとんどない主張をする、根拠のない記事を発表したため解雇された。

questions.stem: A: I can't believe I was ( ) into buying such a bad car. It was a total waste of money! B: I told you to get a second opinion before making the purchase.
questions.translation: そんなにひどい車を買うようだまされたなんて信じられない。まったくお金の無駄だった。

questions.stem: When the man lost his job, he had no choice but to ( ) his watch. It was a lastditch effort to raise enough money to pay his rent.
questions.translation: その男性は仕事を失うと、家賃を払うためのお金を何とか作る最後の手段として、時計を質に入れるしかなかった。

questions.stem: With the final exams just a month away, now is the time for students to ( ) and study hard. There will be plenty of time for relaxation after school is finished.
questions.translation: 期末試験まであと1か月なので、今こそ本腰を入れて一生懸命勉強するときだ。学校が終われば休む時間はたくさんある。

questions.stem: An increase in drunk drivers has caused police to ( ). They are setting up roadblocks and giving random breath tests.
questions.translation: 飲酒運転の増加を受け、警察は厳しい取り締まりを始めた。道路封鎖を行い、無作為の呼気検査をしている。

questions.stem: When his friend from another town suddenly arrived, Rick had to ( ) some food and drink quickly. Luckily, he had some snacks and soda in his refrigerator.
questions.translation: 別の町に住む友人が突然来たので、リックは急いで食べ物と飲み物を用意しなければならなかった。幸い冷蔵庫に軽食とソーダがあった。

questions.stem: When unexpected problems ( ), it is important to remain calm and think logically about how to solve them.
questions.translation: 予期しない問題が起きたときは、落ち着いて論理的に解決方法を考えることが重要だ。
